logline: 하늘의 베 짜는 처녀와 소 치는 총각이 서로에게 빠져 제 일을 놓아 버린다.
destination: 은하수 — 두 사람 사이를 가르는 강
protagonist: 긴 머리를 늘어뜨린 하늘의 젊은 여인
setting: 옛이야기 속 하늘 나라, 베틀과 은하수
anchor: a young woman of the sky with long dark hair, flowing pale silk robes
palette: night indigo, star silver, pale rose, warm amber, cloud grey

weaver.label: 직녀
weaver.desc: a young woman with long dark hair, flowing pale silk robes with wide sleeves, bare feet

herder.label: 견우
herder.desc: a young man with hair in a topknot, plain hemp jacket and trousers, a rope over his shoulder

loom.label: 하늘의 베틀
loom.desc: a wooden loom threaded with shimmering cloth, spools and shuttle, star-lit floor

magpies.label: 까치 떼
magpies.desc: a dense flock of black and white magpies, wings spread, packed wing to wing

beats.visual: a young woman at a wooden loom throwing a shuttle through shimmering cloth, stars beyond
beats.motion: the shuttle flies across the warp, threads tighten, starlight shifts on the cloth

beats.beat: 견우가 소를 몰고 그 앞을 지난다.
beats.visual: a young man in hemp clothes leading an ox past a lit doorway on a starlit slope
beats.motion: he walks forward across the slope, the ox's head swings, dust glitters underfoot

beats.visual: a woman in silk and a man in hemp facing each other on a starlit slope, loom lit behind
beats.motion: they turn toward each other, her sleeves lift, the ox's rope slackens and falls

beats.beat: 베틀에 실이 엉킨 채 멈춰 있다.
beats.visual: an abandoned loom with tangled threads and a dropped shuttle, cloth half woven
beats.motion: loose threads sway across the warp, the shuttle rocks and stops, dust settles

beats.visual: a broad river of stars opening between a woman in silk and a man in hemp, both pulled apart
beats.motion: the star river widens between them, their hands stretch across it, light streams

beats.visual: a woman in pale silk at the edge of a river of stars, a far figure on the other bank
beats.motion: star current flows past her feet, her sleeves drift, the far bank shimmers

beats.beat: 까치들이 강 위로 모여 몸을 잇는다.
beats.visual: a dense flock of magpies packing wing to wing across a river of stars, forming a span
beats.motion: the birds crowd inward across the gap, wings lock together, starlight breaks on them

beats.beat: 빈 강 위에 깃털 하나가 떠 있다.
beats.visual: a single black and white feather drifting above a wide river of stars, both banks empty
beats.motion: the feather turns in the star current, light drifts past, the banks fade

withheld: 두 사람이 한 해에 하루 만나게 되는 사연과, 그날 내리는 비의 뜻
